title: 矽晶圓線鋸切片
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解切縫、TTV、次表面損傷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore kerf, ttv and subsurface damage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 晶棒與切片預算
stages.description: 在「晶棒與切片預算」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for ingot and slicing budget, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 辨識晶向
steps.objective: 完成「辨識晶向」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify crystal orientation, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：辨識晶向。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify crystal orientation. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「辨識晶向」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for identify crystal orientation: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 辨識晶向的原理
knowledge.text: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。
knowledge.textEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「矽晶圓線鋸切片」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「辨識晶向」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：切片厚度相同仍可能有不同鋸損與表面損傷。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「晶圓城夜班：來料、廠務與搬運」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：矽晶圓線鋸切片 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「切片厚度相同仍可能有不同鋸損與表面損傷」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Silicon wafer wire sawing as the task boundary. After reading “Identify crystal orientation”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Equal slice thickness can conceal different kerf loss and surface damage. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Wafer City night shift: incoming material, utilities and logistics”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Silicon wafer wire sawing: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Equal slice thickness can conceal different kerf loss and surface damage” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「辨識晶向」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating identify crystal orientation?
options: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。
TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。
只量中心厚度即可代表全片形貌。
optionsEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance.
TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable.
Center thickness alone represents full-wafer geometry.
quiz.explanation: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
quiz.explanationEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

steps.title: 定義可用晶棒長
steps.objective: 完成「定義可用晶棒長」的對照表，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for define usable ingot length, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：定義可用晶棒長。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：頭尾排除長度會改變可用片數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define usable ingot length. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Head and tail exclusions change usable wafer count. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頭尾排除長度會改變可用片數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Head and tail exclusions change usable wafer count. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「定義可用晶棒長」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define usable ingot length and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「定義可用晶棒長」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for define usable ingot length: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 切縫預算
steps.objective: 完成「切縫預算」的敏感度草圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for budget kerf, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：切縫預算。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：每片占用長度包含晶圓厚度與切縫。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂算例：可用晶棒長 100 mm、切片厚 0.8 mm、切縫 0.2 mm；先求理想片數，再將切縫改為 0.25 mm 比較整數片數，列出尚未納入的端損與不良片。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget kerf. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Length consumed per slice includes wafer thickness and kerf. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical exercise: usable ingot length 100 mm, slice thickness 0.8 mm and kerf 0.2 mm. Calculate ideal integer count, change kerf to 0.25 mm and list excluded end losses and rejects.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「每片占用長度包含晶圓厚度與切縫。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget kerf and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「切縫預算」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for budget kerf: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for reserve thickness allowance, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：厚度留量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：切片厚度還須支付損傷移除與拋光留量。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Reserve thickness allowance. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Sliced thickness must cover damage removal and polishing allowance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「切片厚度還須支付損傷移除與拋光留量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「厚度留量」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for reserve thickness allowance: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：固定端受力圖。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：偏心固定會讓進給負荷在切片中不均。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw mounting loads. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Eccentric mounting makes feed loading asymmetric. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「偏心固定會讓進給負荷在切片中不均。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for draw mounting loads: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

knowledge.text: 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

quiz.question: 評估「來料電阻率分區」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating map incoming resistivity?
options: TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。
只量中心厚度即可代表全片形貌。
沿晶棒的電阻率變化不能用單片平均值代表。
optionsEn: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable.
Center thickness alone represents full-wafer geometry.
One wafer average cannot describe axial resistivity variation.
quiz.explanation: 沿晶棒的電阻率變化不能用單片平均值代表。 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
quiz.explanationEn: One wafer average cannot describe axial resistivity variation. Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.
